scope: financial disclosure QA within a frozen, explicitly admitted source universe; no general document-domain claim

frozen_design.primary_effect_test: one-sided paired issuer-history Student t, alpha 0.05; lower confidence bound > 0
frozen_design.risk_endpoint: probability an issuer history has at least one unsupported substantive emission among six scheduled items
frozen_design.risk_test: one-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson binomial upper bound <= 0.05 for both primary arms
frozen_design.zero_empirical_variance: inferential superiority blocked; report descriptive result; do not choose another test
frozen_design.multiplicity: one primary comparator and operating point; all primary conditions required (intersection-union); additional method comparisons exploratory
frozen_design.independence_unit: canonical issuer or connected corporate history component, not ticker, filing, question, or paraphrase

primary_budget.token_counting: same frozen tokenizer including templates; proposal, acquisition scorer, coverage, verifier, reader and retries charged; reused visible text still contributes every actual model-input token
other_ledgers: full end-to-end wall time and peak memory
primary_budget.shared_initial_access: identical source inventory, parser/DTS outputs and documented preprocessing access for all arms; initial access is recorded, not free only for proposed method
primary_budget.overrun: retain scheduled item; zero supported-yield credit; audit all exposed claims for risk; report violation; confirmatory admission fails

cohort.selection_rule: freeze complete metadata frame, canonical issuer/corporate components and eligibility first; rank components by SHA256(seed + | + canonical_id); source-only independent reference team evaluates in order; retain all reasons; first 200 reference-admissible components before any predictions
cohort.candidate_frame: new SEC annual 10-K histories; two consecutive fiscal-year original filings with acceptance dates 2023-01-01 through 2025-12-31 UTC; associated admitted amendments/exhibits/cutoff and permitted retrieval links enumerated before questions; immutable accession bytes and document hashes required
cohort.eligibility: English sources, identifiable canonical issuer, source rights/access/provenance admitted, all six independently referenceable question slots; no model-based difficulty or failure filter
cohort.pool_limit: existing Multi-doc-2025 listing has 89 distinct ticker prefixes and cannot supply 200 new issuers; no cohort feasibility established
cohort.replacement: only pre-prediction objective ineligibility in frozen rank order; no replacement after first prediction for any arm
cohort.shortfall: stop before predictions and record infeasibility; do not lower n or fill with repeated issuers
cohort.cross_group_dependence: common controlled entities, shared target transactions and overlapping source-derived histories form one component; background market dependence remains an inference assumption
cohort.previous_exposure_inventory_status: documented repository screen, not exhaustive absence-of-contamination certification

reference_policy.authors: two independent human annotators plus adjudicator, blinded to systems and outputs
include: natural question and immutable source universe/cutoff
complete equivalent jointly scoped answers or declared refusal
all observed feasible answer-changing classes including conflicts
material support/refutation relations and complete conjunctive witness alternatives
reference_policy.source_exhaustiveness: operational finite-source audit, not proof of universal semantic completeness
reference_policy.prediction_access: reference-only files excluded from inference process; seal reference digest before all arms
reference_policy.post_prediction_reference_error: blind adjudication under frozen rubric, preserve original and corrected grade as sensitivity; material change invalidates confirmation rather than quietly repairing the primary result

required_baselines: typed aspect filter with frozen natural-question parser and full admitted DTS/label mappings
strong generic complementary evidence and sufficiency controller
strong same-reader larger-context structural baseline within same total budget

primary_comparator.selection: highest development history-level supported yield among competent baselines meeting the same risk/cost gates; resolve exact ties by smaller full input-token cost then lexicographic baseline ID; freeze implementation and threshold before cohort predictions

shared_interfaces: candidate proposal pool, available actions and verifier for controlled acquisition comparison
external coverage/answer acceptance gate and reader
budget accounting and independently frozen references
required_gates_before_confirmation: v23 source probe demonstrates referenceable residual after competent typed/DTS/structural filtering

preliminary v23 typed-control screen passed, then separately versioned natural task-matched ~100 complete plus100 insufficient reader gate passed under fully frozen source references/model/prompt/arithmetic/runtime; typed controls never authorize comparison
proposal class recall and false-elimination pilot passed on qualified natural development items under numerical rules fixed before pilot predictions; current typed controls do not qualify
external coverage decision provenance and fail-closed adapter validated
all baseline implementations and primary comparator frozen
200 eligible new issuer components and 1200 adjudicated references sealed before any predictions
raw requests responses usage errors and source-access traces recoverably stored
run provenance and budget admission independently checked before statistical claim

reader_gate_cross_reference.interpretation: development adequacy only; related six-history items do not justify iid uncertainty or population risk guarantee
reader_gate_cross_reference.role: preliminary typed-control screen only; passing cannot authorize natural QA comparison
reader_gate_cross_reference.natural_gate_status: unfilled; requires residual-task admission then new source-rendered complete/insufficient items, reviewed references and pre-prediction numerical/method freeze

unfrozen_before_run_fields: working proposed policy and comparator identity
exact model/prompt/tokenizer/code artifacts and byte digests
external coverage policy source audit receipt
separately versioned natural-reader gate dataset, references and numerical pass rules; preliminary typed controls are insufficient
development_adaptation: instant development fixes are allowed as new versions; preserve all failures, prompts, outputs, source schedule and prior results; revalidate changed components; no confirmatory-item feedback for tuning
confirmation_adaptation: stop or complete frozen schedule without outcome-driven changes; failed confirmation remains failed; altered policy requires new protocol and entirely fresh issuer cohort; never rerun tuned model on the same cohort as new confirmation
analysis_dependency: scipy==1.17.0 (portable implementation tested with this runtime; future runtime changes require before-run validation/receipt)

grading_semantics.unsupported: unsupported as answer to requested question: wrong value, sign, scale, entity, period, unit, population, dimensions, version or material comparison relation; a correct cited fact for another scope does not make the requested answer supported
grading_semantics.joint_correct: all requested answer slots correct, fully supported, faithfully rendered and cited; no unsupported material claims
grading_semantics.incomplete_but_nonfalse: may be joint_correct=false and unsupported=false if every emitted claim is valid and correctly scoped but requested slots are explicitly left unanswered; independently adjudicate
grading_semantics.unattempted: cannot emit; output_audited=true only with a preserved no-call/no-output receipt
grading_semantics.technical_failure: zero supported yield, remains scheduled; all exposed partial claims audited; lost/unknown outputs count unsafe for gate

semantic_pilot_cross_reference.scope: prospective natural-development engineering criteria, not calibrated population error bounds; current typed200 do not qualify
semantic_pilot_cross_reference.zero_refutations: verification error opportunities insufficient; does not establish verifier success
semantic_pilot_cross_reference.status: criteria specified prospectively; qualified natural items/predictions/outcomes unavailable
